statements.status_notes: GHSA-h749-fxx7-pwpg (CVE-2026-39414) documents unbounded memory allocation in the S3 Select CSV reader's nextSplit() (internal/s3select/csv/reader.go), present in every open-source minio/minio release since commit 7c14cdb60e53dbfdad2be644dfb180cab19fffa7. This image ships a security-patched build that includes a fix for this CSV nextSplit() path, so the vulnerable code this advisory describes is not present in the shipped binary.

False positive. CVE-2018-1000538 documents an unbounded write-to-RAM allocation in MinIO server releases before RELEASE.2018-05-16T23-35-33Z, fixed in minio/minio commit 9c8b7306f55f2c8c0a5c7cea9a8db9d34be8faa7. The Go pseudo-version this build resolves to (0.0.0-20260828092409-f6cf36764a84+dirty) encodes a source commit from 2026, more than seven years after that fix, so the pre-fix allocation code this advisory covers is not present. The scanner cannot compare the pseudo-version against the legacy dated release tag used by the advisory, which is why it is flagged.
